propositions: Multiple bundles for a single ref cause clone to fail with 'multiple updates for ref not allowed' and push to stall because git-remote-s3 rejects writes while bundles > 1, making the store unclonable and unpushable

Upstream git_remote_s3 Doctor.fix_multiple_bundles is interactive-only (blocking input() on EOF) and discards non-chosen heads, losing unique events from append-only store; rebar's tickets-branch is an event log where divergent heads carry distinct events and must all be retained

The heal must write a merged tip as a new bundle before deleting originals and never delete the merged tip, so ≥1 lossless bundle remains at every crash point; crash mid-delete re-triggers heal on next run

The heal acquires git-remote-s3's own per-ref lock (IfNoneMatch conditional-put, 60s TTL), re-enumerates bundles under lock (TOCTOU guard), fetches every head locally, then folds them via iterated 2-parent git merges following sync's lossless-merge semantics, writing the merged tip before deleting originals

On non-derived-file conflict, the heal aborts without deleting any bundle, releases lock, and surfaces fsck-recover hint rather than discarding a parent; concurrent doctors serialize via the shared lock (one heals, others back off and converge on winner's collapsed remote)

Detection integrates into push.py: a narrow _is_multi_bundle predicate matches 'multiple bundles exists on server' and 'multiple updates for ref' stderr signatures; push retries once after heal via healed_once guard, then converges normally (ordinary git path against the now-single bundle)
